a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'operate until 8' plan almost certainly ends with both of us failing. The reserve only holds 4, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the plan. If the storm doesn't hit, I'll operate with you afterward so you can fill your unit.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. If we get another round, I'll operate every round with you so you can take 4 as soon as the reserve allows. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
